summary: The registrant CN Healthy Food Tech Group Corp. disclosed via Form 8-K Item 8.01 that its subsidiaries received an Advance Notice of Administrative Penalty from the CSRC's Heilongjiang Regulatory Bureau. The CSRC determined that the company failed to complete mandatory offshore listing filing procedures prior to its September 2025 Nasdaq listing via a merger with Iron Horse Acquisition Company, violating Articles 13 and 19(1) of the Trial Administrative Measures. Proposed fines are RMB3,000,000 (~$440,000) on Zhongneng Liangke and RMB1,500,000 (~$220,000) on CEO Zhenjun Jiang. The recipients have five days to defend or request a hearing. This is a regulatory penalty notice, not a special-situation corporate event. Watch for any appeals or further CSRC actions.
